description.en: Appearance skins for the DeepSeek Harness web client: six presets with light and dark palettes, thirteen header styles, seventeen composer styles, plus colour, font and background controls. Offline, persistent, and upgrade-safe.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端外观皮肤：六套预设（含深浅色）、十三种顶栏风格、十七种输入框风格，加上主色 / 字体 / 背景独立定制。离线可用、设置持久化、宿主升级不破版。

description.en: Six presets with light and dark palettes, thirteen header styles and seventeen composer styles for the DSH web UI, plus primary / neutral / text colours, Chinese and English fonts, and a background image. Settings persist locally; no web fonts.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web UI 的六套预设（含深浅色）、十三种顶栏风格、十七种输入框风格，支持主色 / 中性色 / 字体色、中英文字体、背景图。设置存在本地，刷新后仍在；不加载任何网络字体。
